title: Halves and quarters with a pizza
examples: Which is bigger, a half or a quarter?
How many quarters make a whole?

explain.say: Look at the pizza on the board. It is cut into 2 equal pieces. Each piece is one half. One of the 2 equal parts is shaded.

draw.text: Halves and quarters with a pizza

explain.say: 2 halves make 1 whole pizza. Equal means the same size. Both halves must be the same size. Can you draw a line to cut a circle in half?
Now the pizza is cut into 4 equal pieces. Each piece is one quarter. One of the 4 equal parts is shaded. Is a quarter bigger or smaller than a half?
Look at the 2 bars on the board. One half is bigger than one quarter. More equal pieces means each piece is smaller. Which bar has more shaded?
Look at the shaded parts. 2 quarters are the same size as 1 half. Today, fold a piece of paper in half. Then fold it again to make quarters.

faq.a: A half is one of two equal parts. When you cut something into two pieces the same size, each piece is a half.
A quarter is one of four equal parts. Four quarters make one whole.

faq.q: Which is bigger, a half or a quarter?
faq.a: A half is bigger. When you share between more people, each piece gets smaller.
asks: Is a quarter bigger than a half?

faq.q: Why must the parts be equal?
faq.a: Halves and quarters only count if every piece is the same size. Unequal pieces are not fair, and they are not halves or quarters.
asks: Do halves have to be the same size?

faq.q: How can I practise fractions at home?
faq.a: Fold paper, or cut fruit or a sandwich with a grown-up. Say how many equal parts there are each time.

quiz.say: Count the pieces. How many quarters make a whole pizza?
quiz.show: 🍕 How many quarters make a whole?
quiz.why: A quarter is 1 of 4 equal parts. So 4 quarters make a whole.

wrong.1: 3 quarters is 1 piece less than a whole.

quiz.say: Think about 2 pizzas of the same size. Which piece is bigger?
quiz.why: A half is 1 of 2 equal parts. Fewer pieces means each piece is bigger.

wrong.0: A quarter is smaller, because the pizza is cut into 4.
wrong.2: 2 quarters fit inside 1 half, so the sizes are different.
